summary: Direct I/O ACK and write-receipt routing between TCP/TLS socket tasks, the coordinator input queue, and a delivery shard inbox (--delivery-shards K >= 1, ADR 0066). Models ShardAckBudget credit reservation, single-packet zero-credit reads for non-ACK packets (PINGREQ), parking an unpaid ACK ahead of subsequent packets (DISCONNECT) via ConnCore::park_unpaid_ack, credit retention through DeliveryShardWorker.ack_inputs, and single-slot WriteSlot accounting across Started and terminal Written events. Configurations prove budget conservation, DISCONNECT ordering, and terminal delivery, witness zero-credit non-ACK progress, and refute three mutants.
not_replayed: All safety invariants, zero-credit non-ACK reachability, and mutant counterexamples are replayed by TCP and TLS tests in net.rs and runtime_tests.rs.
